test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an environmental concern?

options.text: Increasing consumption and use of plastics

solution:
The correct answer is __**Raising the ozone layer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Environmental Concern**

 
 
• Environmental concerns are the **results of human activities in the biophysical environment, most frequently negative consequences** that lead to the **degradation** of the ecosystem.
 
• The term **"environment" **refers to both **living and non-living **elements of nature.
 
• **Environmental degradation **is the deterioration of the environment as a result of r**esource depletion, including poor soil, water, and air quality, ecosystem disruption, habitat loss, the extinction of wildlife, and pollution**.
 
• Major current **environmental concerns** are:
 
 
• Climate change
 
• **Growing pollution levels**
 
• **Global warming**
 
• **increasing consumption and use of plastics**
 
• Water scarcity
 
• Deforestation
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **practice of environmental protection involves safeguarding the natural environment **at the individual, group, or governmental levels for the benefit of both the environment and people. 
 
• **Raising the Ozone layer** is not an environmental concern. Even it is good for the conservation of the environment.
 
• The** ultraviolet (UV) radiation that destroys living tissue, such as that of people and plants, is blocked by the ozone layer **in the upper atmosphere.
 
• Hence, by raising the ozone layer, it will **absorb more UV rays and protect the environment from being harmed**.
